verdicts.reason: A and B are nearly identical, and both make the same mistakes. The left circle no longer bleeds off the canvas edge as it does in the original. It now sits as a whole circle behind the quote and attribution, so it competes with the text. The product can stays small and floats inside the large maroon circle, and there is a lot of empty space below the attribution. A spaces the attribution slightly more like the original. B sits the sun closer to the can and moves the logo and can up a little. Neither difference makes one better than the other.
